english.note: Use 一流 when classical simply means first-rate or excellent, rather than historically canonical.
Use this to praise someone or something as excellent or first-rate, such as a top lawyer.

examples.english: At the classical music concert, the violinist’s performance was truly first-rate.
examples.traditional: 古典音樂會入面，個小提琴手嘅演奏真係一流。
